name: Recombinant humanised type III collagen, 30-aa COL3A1 domain x16
species: Sixteen tandem repeats of the Homo sapiens COL3A1 functional domain

expression.rationale: 同家族16×、TEV及尾序列构建路线；本行FASTA不等于载体融合全长，需匹配标签与酶切后序列。

description: The same COL3A1 functional domain repeated sixteen times; the longer construct behind the platform's injectable gel.
registrations: NMPA registration no. 20213130488 — recombinant type III humanised collagen lyophilised fibre, approved 2021
NMPA registration no. 20253130751 — injectable gel, approved 2025 for mid-face volume and contour correction
registration_note: The registration numbers belong to the related platform and product. Whether the commercial product sequence is exactly the variant listed here requires confirmation from the company's batch records.
product_use: Related platform products include recombinant type III humanised collagen lyophilised fibre, injectable gel and repair-class devices.
potential_uses: Platform-related applications: injectable lyophilised-fibre dermal filler for facial wrinkles, injectable gel for mid-face volume and contour correction, and wound and skin repair solutions or dressings. The correspondence between the sixteen-repeat construct and specific products has not been publicly confirmed.
evidence_limits: Jinbo HC8/HC16 and the 16x repeat construct: in-patent data; the PDB entry is a related short functional domain, not a complete 480–501 aa model. | Jinbo HC8/HC16 and the 16x repeat construct: paper materials were supplied by the company and cannot substitute for clinical evaluation of a specific finished product. | Jinbo-related medical devices: public abstracts do not include the full registration testing and clinical reports; request them from NMPA or the company.

sequences.product_use: 相关平台产品包括重组III型人源化胶原蛋白冻干纤维、注射用凝胶及修复类器械。
sequences.regulatory_status: 是（相关平台/产品）：国械注准20213130488、国械注准20253130751；商业成品序列是否恰为所列变体需企业批记录确认。

experiments.group: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体；锦波相关医疗器械
experiments.level: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：E1 | 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：E2 | 锦波相关医疗器械：E4/E5
experiments.specific_experiments: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：SDS-PAGE、质谱、Ni-NTA/阴离子交换、内毒素、长期稳定性、晶体结构 | 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：细胞黏附、成纤维细胞行为/ECM表达 | 锦波相关医疗器械：注册临床/人体使用与监管审评、上市后使用
experiments.principal_result: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：专利报告高纯度、≤5 EU/mL内毒素目标、半年以上水溶液稳定性；相关功能区有PDB 6A0A/6A0C。 | 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：相对对照显示黏附及细胞外基质相关指标改善。 | 锦波相关医疗器械：冻干纤维2021获批；注射凝胶2025获批用于中面部容量/轮廓矫正。
experiments.result_location: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：US11396537B2 Fig.1–7、Examples；PDB 6A0A/6A0C | 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：US11396537B2 Fig.2；https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s42825-022-00103-5 | 锦波相关医疗器械：国械注准20213130488；国械注准20253130751；表内监管URL
experiments.evidence_limitations: 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：专利内部数据；PDB为相关短功能区，不是完整480–501 aa模型。 | 锦波 HC8/HC16及16×重复构建体：论文材料由企业提供；不能替代具体成品临床评价。 | 锦波相关医疗器械：公开摘要未给出完整注册检验和临床报告，需向NMPA/企业索取。
